# Units and stats reference

The components every unit carries, the assets that define units, stats, attributes and buffs, and the damage and lookup API. For how to use it, see [Units and stats](../modules/units.md).

## VtUnit

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Units → VtUnit**. Adds [VtUnitModifiers](#vtunitmodifiers), [VtUnitStats](#vtunitstats), [VtUnitTraits](#vtunittraits), [VtUnitBuffs](#vtunitbuffs), [VtCombatEngagement](#vtcombatengagement), [VtUnitAbilities](abilities.md#vtunitabilities), [VtCombatTextAutoSubscriber](combat-text.md#vtcombattextautosubscriber), [VtUnitEquipment](items.md#vtunitequipment) automatically.

Composition root for a gameplay entity (player, enemy, NPC). Owns identity (name / description / targeting priority / faction / tags), the `VtUnitId` used by the rest of the system, and the `IVtAttackable` bridge that plugs into the project's interaction system.

### Inspector fields

#### Definition

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Definition (`definition`) | [VtUnitDefinition](#vtunitdefinition) | None | Baseline stats / identity / traits for this unit. Required. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnitId Id { get; }` | Stable id valid for the lifetime of this `VtUnit`. Use in `VtDamageInfo.attacker`, logs, and cross-system references. |
| `string Name { get; }` | Presentational name — pulled from the definition, falling back to the GameObject name. |
| `string Description { get; }` | Flavor / tooltip description from the definition. |
| `int TargetingPriority { get; }` | Priority used by enemy AI target selection. Base value from the definition plus any TargetingPriority modifier (taunt / stealth). |
| `VtFaction VtFaction { get; }` | VtFaction / team of this unit. |
| `bool HasFactionOverride { get; }` | True while `SetFactionOverride` replaces the definition's faction. |
| `VtUnitDefinition Definition { get; }` | Source definition (read-only). |
| `int Level { get; }` | Current level — the single source of truth for every level gate in the library (item requirements, attribute growth, recipe / quest / buildable prerequisites). Reads the opt-in `VtUnitLevel` sibling when one is attached; otherwise the definition's `startingLevel` (a level-20 mini-boss that never gains XP still *is* level 20); otherwise 1. |
| `IReadOnlyCollection<VtUnitTagDefinition> Tags { get; }` | Live set of tags. Read-only view — mutate via `AddTag` / `RemoveTag`. |
| `bool IsInvulnerable { get; }` | True when the unit is currently invulnerable to all damage and untargetable. Set by `VtRoaming` during the leash-return (mob runs back home untouchable) and any other consumer flow that needs a temporary "no damage at all" state — cinematics, stealth-vanish, teleport-in invulnerability, post-respawn safety windows. |
| `event Action<int, int> OnLeveledUp` | Forwarded from the sibling `VtUnitLevel.OnLeveledUp`. Args: (oldLevel, newLevel). Subscribe here rather than on the level component so the subscription survives the sibling being attached after your `OnEnable` ran — `SeedFromDefinition` attaches it late. Never fires for units without a level component. |
| `static event Action<VtUnit> OnAnyUnitSeeded` | Fires on every instance after a unit was seeded from its definition, on enable and on `SetDefinition`. World-level systems use it to apply their state to units that appear later, such as the active day phase's modifiers. Subscribers must unsubscribe when they are disabled. |
| `void SetFactionOverride(VtFaction faction)` | Replace the definition's faction on this instance, for summons that fight for their owner or charmed units. Not authority-gated: set it on every copy, which replication does. |
| `void ClearFactionOverride()` | Return to the definition's faction. |
| `void RebindLevel()` | Re-discover the sibling `VtUnitLevel` and refresh the `OnLeveledUp` forwarding subscription. Idempotent. Called from `OnEnable`, `SeedFromDefinition`, and from `VtUnitLevel.Initialize` when the component is added after this unit already cached its absence (same late-attach contract as `VtCombatEngagement.RebindThreatTable`). |
| `bool HasTag(VtUnitTagDefinition tag)` | True if the unit currently has this tag. Compares by asset reference (Unity GUID). |
| `bool IsImmuneTo(VtCcCategory category)` | True if the unit is immune to the given crowd-control category. Read by `VtApplyBuffEffect` and the taunt effects to refuse application before any state mutates. Source: `VtUnitDefinition.ccImmunities`. Returns false for `VtCcCategory.None` (a non-CC buff is never "immune to nothing"). |
| `bool IsImmuneTo(VtDamageType type)` | True if the unit is immune to the given damage type. Read by `VtUnitStats.TakeDamage` for an early-exit + Immune combat-text fire. Source: `VtUnitDefinition.damageImmunities`. |
| `void SetInvulnerable(bool value)` | Toggle the unit's invulnerability flag. Authority-gated. The damage pipeline (`VtUnitStats.TakeDamage`) and target-selection (`IVtAttackable.CanBeAttacked`) both honor this. |
| `void AddTag(VtUnitTagDefinition tag)` | Add a tag at runtime (e.g. buff-granted "Cursed" flag). No-op if already present or null. |
| `void RemoveTag(VtUnitTagDefinition tag)` | Remove a tag at runtime. No-op if missing or null. |
| `void SetDefinition(VtUnitDefinition def)` | Late-binding entry point for code that spawns a unit with a specific definition (waves, quests). Also triggers a re-seed if called at runtime. |
| `int TakeDamage(VtDamageInfo info)` | Typed overload — callers that have built a `VtDamageInfo` (weapons with crit/attack-type data, projectiles) should prefer this. |

## VtUnitDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Units → Unit Definition**.

Designer-authored baseline for a unit's identity, resources, combat values, and innate modifiers / traits. Used by players, enemies, and NPCs alike — the `VtUnit` component reads this at enable time and seeds the live `VtUnitStats` / `VtUnitModifiers` / `VtUnitTraits`.

### Inspector fields

#### Identity

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier — the DB / network payload key for this unit archetype. Convention: lowercase dotted, e.g. 'unit.skeleton_warrior', 'unit.player', 'unit.boss_lich_king'. Unique across all VtUnitDefinition assets in the project. Saves and network messages refer to units by this id, so changing it breaks existing saves. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI display name shown to players. Falls back to GameObject.name if empty. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Tooltip / bestiary description. |
| Portrait (`portrait`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Portrait shown on a unit frame. Empty: the frame renders the unit's model through a portrait studio when the scene has one, or shows its initials. |
| Icon Id (`iconId`) | `string` | Empty |  | A small icon from the Vantage icon set by name, such as skull or shield, shown next to the level on a unit frame to mark what kind of unit it is. |
| Faction (`faction`) | [VtFaction](#vtfaction) | `Neutral` |  | Team / allegiance — drives targeting filters and friendly-fire checks. |
| Targeting Priority (`targetingPriority`) | `int` | 50 |  | Base priority used by enemy AI target selection. Heroes ≈ 100, workers ≈ 20, basic units ≈ 50. |
| Tags (`tags`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](#vtunittagdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Categorical labels for this unit — drag in VtUnitTagDefinition assets (Undead.asset, Beast.asset, Humanoid.asset, …). Consumers: quest objectives ('kill 10 Undead'), vs-type items, targeting filters, bestiary UI. Query at runtime via VtUnit.HasTag(tagAsset). Host-game-specific — author your tag assets in Assets/Data/Units/Tags/. |

#### Resources (HP / MP / Stamina / ...)

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pools (`pools`) | [VtResourcePoolConfig](#vtresourcepoolconfig)[] | Empty |  | Which resource pools this unit has. Most units: HP only. Players: HP + Stamina. RPG classes add MP / Rage / Energy / etc. |

#### Progression

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starting Level (`startingLevel`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Level the unit spawns at. Players usually start at 1; a lvl-20 mini-boss in a mid-game dungeon can be authored at 20 directly without granting XP. Drives XP rewards on death, level-scaled formulas, and any 'kill 10 lvl-5+ beasts'-style quest filters. |

#### Primary Attributes (optional — for VtAttributeDerivedStatsBinding)

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base Attributes (`baseAttributes`) | [VtAttributeGrant](#vtattributegrant)[] | Empty |  | Baseline values of primary attributes at level 1 (drag in VtAttributeDefinition assets plus a starting value). Used only if VtAttributeDerivedStatsBinding is attached. Items / buffs / level-up grants stack on top via the normal modifier channel. |
| Attribute Growth Per Level (`attributeGrowthPerLevel`) | [VtAttributeGrowth](#vtattributegrowth)[] | Empty |  | Per-level attribute gain — '+2.5 STR per level'. Each entry adds (currentLevel - 1) * perLevel to the attribute total on top of baseAttributes. Requires VtAttributeDerivedStatsBinding; applied at spawn (honoring startingLevel) and on every level-up. |

#### Basic Attack

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Min Damage (`minDamage`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Minimum damage of the unit's basic attack (before weapon / modifier scaling). |
| Max Damage (`maxDamage`) | `int` | 2 | ≥ 0 | Maximum damage of the unit's basic attack. |
| Damage Type (`damageType`) | [VtDamageType](#vtdamagetype) | `Physical` |  | Element of the basic attack — routes through resistance channel. |
| Attack Type (`attackType`) | [VtAttackType](#vtattacktype) | `Normal` |  | Matrix axis — keyed into VtDamageMatrix against the defender's armor type. Default flat matrix means this is just a tag; consumers extend VtAttackType + author matrix cells to give it gameplay impact. |
| Damage Channel (`damageChannel`) | [VtDamageChannel](#vtdamagechannel) | `Melee` |  | RPG class channel — Melee / Ranged / Magic. Drives power-stat scaling (Magic → spellPower, else physicalPower) and gear / proc filtering. Distinct from attackType: a melee unit typically sets channel = Melee here. |
| Attack Range (`attackRange`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0 | Base attack range in world units. Read by the shared basic-attack ability when its 'sourceRangeFromUnitAttackRange' flag is on. Lets one ability asset serve many mobs that each have their own reach. |
| Attack Interval (`attackInterval`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0.05 | Base seconds between basic attacks. Read by the shared basic-attack ability when its 'sourceCooldownFromUnitAttackInterval' flag is on. Stacks multiplicatively with stat.attack_speed via the ability's 'scalesWithAttackSpeed' flag. |
| Splash (`splash`) | [VtSplashSpec](#vtsplashspec) | — |  | Optional: AoE splash around each hit. radius = 0 means single-target. |
| Projectile (`projectile`) | [VtProjectileSpec](#vtprojectilespec) | — |  | Optional: travelling projectile config (prefab + speed + arc). Leave prefab empty for melee or hitscan ranged attacks. |

#### Presentation

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Emit Combat Text (`emitCombatText`) | `bool` | On |  | If true, floating damage / heal / dodge text spawns over this unit's head whenever the damage pipeline fires. Flip off for trash mobs, totems, or chatter-heavy swarms where the numbers would clutter the screen. |
| Hit Cue (`hitCue`) | [VtPresentationCue](presentation.md#vtpresentationcue) | — |  | Animator trigger, sound and effect played when this unit takes damage. |
| Death Cue (`deathCue`) | [VtPresentationCue](presentation.md#vtpresentationcue) | — |  | Played when this unit dies. |
| Revive Cue (`reviveCue`) | [VtPresentationCue](presentation.md#vtpresentationcue) | — |  | Played when this unit is revived. |

#### Movement & AI

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Move Speed (`moveSpeed`) | `float` | 3 | ≥ 0 | Base locomotion speed in world units / sec. This is how fast the unit walks/runs around the world — NOT missile or animation speed. |
| Aggro Range (`aggroRange`) | `float` | 8 | ≥ 0 | Notice radius in world units. With Use Hostile AI on, the unit attacks hostile units that come inside it; call-for-help also reaches faction-mates within it. Each unit has its own radius. 0 = never engage on sight. Typical melee mob 6-10, ranged mob 14-20, passive unit 0. |
| Use Hostile Ai (`useHostileAi`) | `bool` | Off |  | Attack hostile units that come inside Aggro Range, and fight back when something targets this unit through threat or a taunt. Attaches VtHostileAi. Leave off for players, NPCs and passive units. |
| Takes Orders (`takesOrders`) | `bool` | Off |  | Players can command this unit with group orders from VtOrderInput: move, attack, attack-move, hold position and stop. While idle it attacks hostile units inside Aggro Range. Attaches VtUnitOrders. Leave Use Hostile AI off. |
| Ability Rotation (`abilityRotation`) | [VtRotationEntry](encounters.md#vtrotationentry)[] | Empty |  | Abilities this unit casts on its own, highest priority first, each with a target rule, a health window and an interval. Non-empty = VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition attaches VtAbilityRotation. Use it for monsters and bosses. |
| Vision Radius (`visionRadius`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | How far this unit reveals the fog of war, in world units. 0 = reveals nothing. Attaches VtVisionSource. |

#### Selection

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Selectable (`selectable`) | `bool` | On |  | Players can select this unit with a click or a box. Turn off for props and scenery. |
| Selection Radius (`selectionRadius`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Radius of the selection marker in world units. 0 = from the unit character controller or collider. |

#### Defense

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Armor Type (`armorType`) | [VtArmorType](#vtarmortype) | `Unarmored` |  | Defender category — keyed into VtDamageMatrix vs the attacker's VtAttackType. Overridable by equipped armor items at higher priority. |

#### Abilities

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic Attack (`basicAttack`) | [VtAbilityDefinition](abilities.md#vtabilitydefinition) | None |  | The ability used for this unit's basic attack — granted at spawn and installed in VtUnitAbilities' auto-fire slot when the unit acquires a target. Most units share a single 'Basic Attack' SO whose damage effect sources numbers from minDamage/maxDamage/damageType/attackType/projectile on this definition (see VtUnitBasicAttackDamageEffect). Leave null for non-combatants. |
| Granted Abilities (`grantedAbilities`) | [VtAbilityDefinition](abilities.md#vtabilitydefinition)[] | Empty |  | Additional abilities granted to this unit at spawn — active spells, cooldown abilities, passives-as-abilities. Players typically add class abilities here; enemies add boss mechanics. Order does not matter. Null / empty = only the basic attack. |

#### Starting Equipment

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starting Equipment (`startingEquipment`) | [VtItemDefinition](items.md#vtitemdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Items auto-equipped when this unit spawns. Each entry is fed to VtUnitEquipment.TryEquip in order — so a 2H weapon ahead of an off-hand shield will block the shield. Useful for sample / NPC authoring; players can also set up loadouts here for the level-1 starting kit. |

#### Starting Inventory

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starting Inventory (`startingInventory`) | [VtStartingInventoryEntry](inventory.md#vtstartinginventoryentry)[] | Empty |  | Items added to this unit's VtUnitInventory at spawn (item + count). Only applied if the unit has a VtUnitInventory component (the inventory module is opt-in — not part of VtUnit's RequireComponent chain). Stackable items merge into a single entry up to maxStackSize; non-stackable items each get their own entry per copy. |

#### Passive Auras

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Passive Auras (`passiveAuras`) | [VtAuraDefinition](auras.md#vtauradefinition)[] | Empty |  | Auras the unit emits as long as it's alive. VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition attaches one VtAuraEmitter per entry at spawn. Mutually-exclusive auras in the list resolve at attach time — only the last attached one stays enabled. |

#### Threat / Aggro

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Use Threat Table (`useThreatTable`) | `bool` | Off |  | Opt-in: when true, VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition attaches a VtThreatTable + VtThreatAutoSubscriber, and VtCombatEngagement automatically follows the top-threat attacker (MMO-style tank/healer/DPS dynamics). Enable on mobs and bosses; leave off on players (who don't benefit from a threat ledger). Off: the unit fights the nearest enemy. |

#### Loot

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loot Table (`lootTable`) | [VtLootTableDefinition](loot.md#vtloottabledefinition) | None |  | Loot table rolled when this unit dies. Null = no drops (most NPCs — citizens, dummy targets, players). Authoring path: drag a VtLootTableDefinition asset; VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition auto-attaches a VtLootDropper that subscribes to OnDied and spawns VtWorldItems at the corpse on death. Authority-gated. |

#### Roaming / Leash

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roam Radius (`roamRadius`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Radius around the unit's spawn position the roaming AI wanders within. 0 = no roaming (most NPCs, players). > 0 = VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition auto-attaches a VtRoaming component that picks random destinations within this radius and walks between them with idle pauses. |
| Leash Radius (`leashRadius`) | `float` | 25 | ≥ 0 | Distance from the spawn position past which the unit gives up chase, drops aggro, and runs back invulnerably (the MMO leash pattern). Should be larger than roamRadius and aggroRange. 0 = no leash break (combat continues regardless of distance — useful for raid bosses with scripted reset triggers instead). |
| Roam Idle Min Seconds (`roamIdleMinSeconds`) | `float` | 2 | ≥ 0 | Lower bound of the roaming idle-pause duration in seconds. The unit waits in place for a random time in [roamIdleMinSeconds, roamIdleMaxSeconds] between walks. |
| Roam Idle Max Seconds (`roamIdleMaxSeconds`) | `float` | 5 | ≥ 0 | Upper bound of the roaming idle-pause duration in seconds. |
| Roam Speed Multiplier (`roamSpeedMultiplier`) | `float` | 0.5 | ≥ 0.1 | Multiplier applied to moveSpeed while roaming (idle wandering). 0.5 = stroll at half combat speed — typical mob feel. |
| Return Speed Multiplier (`returnSpeedMultiplier`) | `float` | 2.5 | ≥ 0.1 | Multiplier applied to moveSpeed while running back to home (leash return). 2.5 = sprint at 2.5x normal speed. Visible signal to the player that the mob is leashing rather than just moving. |

#### Building

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Use Builder (`useBuilder`) | `bool` | Off |  | Opt-in: when true, VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition attaches a VtUnitBuilder component that drives the build / placement loop (ghost preview follows cursor, snap, validate, consume items + currency, spawn prefab). Enable on player units. Default false. |

#### Resource Node

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resource Node (`resourceNode`) | [VtResourceNodeDefinition](resource-nodes.md#vtresourcenodedefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, VtUnit.SeedFromDefinition attaches a VtResourceNode component on this unit, turning it into a tree / ore vein / fishing spot. The referenced VtResourceNodeDefinition drives per-hit yield, tool / skill / damage-type gating, respawn cadence, and visual swap. Null = not a node. |
